Find available taper equations by family or species

Source: R/stem-registry.R
taper_models.Rd

Find available taper equations by family or species

Usage

taper_models(
  family = NULL,
  spcd = NULL
)

Arguments

family

The family groups taper models that use the same equation form. Character vector of family names. Default: NULL.

spcd

The species codes limit the trees this model covers. Numeric vector of species codes. Default: NULL.

Value

A data frame describing registered models:

  • Identification: id, family, kernel, spcd_scope.

  • Logical capabilities: has_dob, has_inverse, has_integral.

  • Verification: oracle_verified, logical.

  • Internal units: measurement_system and stump_ht in that system's height unit.

  • Registration: owner_package, source, generation (revision number).

Examples

## Load data verbs
library(dplyr)

## List models covering an example species
models <- taper_models(spcd = example_trees$spcd[1])

## Show model identifiers and capabilities
models %>%
  select(id, family, has_dob, has_inverse, has_integral) %>%
  head(n = 3)
#>            id         family has_dob has_inverse has_integral
#> 3  100FW2W202 flewelling_2pt    TRUE       FALSE         TRUE
#> 36 100JB2W202       r1_taper   FALSE        TRUE         TRUE
#> 37 200CZ2W202       r2_taper   FALSE        TRUE         TRUE
